body.x: Hicodo has displayed a story coding, which allows to learn coding in a fun way, in ‘MIK INNOVATION HOT SPOT & MIK NIGHT’ (BOOTH # 52843) of CES 2019 EUREKA PARK, the largest technology show in the world held in Las Vegas, USA for four days starting from January 8 (Tue).

Story coding presents dancing ice princess and Cinderella’s glass shoes. Hicodo is a project-based company which runs a creative smart education for people from the age of 4 to more. It is providing education service and is researching and developing creative content. It is trying to help fulfill individual’s dream through “maker-education.”

The current coding education is complicated to control, and it is expensive. To solve this kind of problem, Hicodo eliminated unnecessary parts of the system and developed a product to make coding education easier and more fun.

Story coding is produced through the Arduino module combination method in a design of the paper box, and it also provides easy activity workbook which helps to understand basic concepts of coding. Through the use of input and output sensor and module, one can make a personalized story and create art work by decorating it. The advantage of this product is that it provides creative STEAM education mixed with coding, art, and science.
